name: droptrack
description: Analyze your music with DropTrack, then turn track insights into stronger promotion, submissions, campaigns, and audience growth.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze tracks and grow your music career with AI.
interface.longDescription: Analyze your tracks with DropTrack directly from your AI assistant. Upload audio, use an existing DropTrack track, or provide a supported music link to inspect structured track analysis and tags, then discover personalized submission opportunities for labels, DJs, bloggers, and playlist curators. Turn those insights into practical promotion: explore playlists, organize contacts and lists, prepare campaign drafts, review campaign and audience performance, manage Grow advertising and assets, and create press releases, artist bios, and artwork. Every advertised workflow is customer-facing and scoped to the companies, data, and permissions available to your signed-in DropTrack account.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my newest track and explain the results in plain language.
Find submission opportunities that fit my newest track.
Compare engagement across my recent campaigns.
